name: isl40_scarce
_about: Main experiment on the 40-word corpus (plus INCLUDE clips for three of its thin words, fetched from inside the zips): the 8 legacy words get K training clips, the other words keep their whole pool (~10 clips after the signer-independent test split). min_clips 16 keeps the words with >= 16 clips (32: 29 from the corpus, plus brother, home and me from INCLUDE Brother, House, I); the other thin words join once recorded (bump data.isl40.revision so every member uses the same corpus). One K per member.
